spans.s:
छवि छवि, इस्, or छवी, f. (the latter only
in Ved.; said to be fr. rt. छो), skin, hide; hue,
colour of the skin, colour in general; beauty, splen-
dor, brilliance; light, lustre; [cf. कृष्ण-च्छवि;
cf. also Old Germ. scieri, ‘lucid;’ Hib. sceimh,
‘beauty, bloom;’ sceimheach, ‘handsome.’]

छविल्लाकर छविल्लाकर, अस्, m., N. of an
historian of Kaśmīra.
